title: 第288章 仙会开始第287章 琳琅仙市
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：别人修仙我闲逛，游历三界终长生第一卷：默认第288章仙会开始（..la）“嘿嘿，”
知白笑道：
“公子，这是我们在仙市上买到的好东西，拿过来给你。”
“这么多？”
“你们倒是收获颇丰。”
“进来吧，让我看看你们买了什么好东西。”
纪风侧开身子，让知白他们进来。
一进来，知白他们就将东西放到了桌上。
纪风关上院门，走了过来，目光扫过桌面，知白他们买的东西还真不少。
见纪风过来，知白拿起桌上的一块石头说道：
“公子，这个是流云砚。”
“听绾绾讲，这个流云砚不需要研墨，用时，只需要笔划过砚，就能沾上墨，写出来的字跟流云一样。”
“公子有了这流云砚，以后写字、画画，就不需要研磨了。”
“还有这个......”
桃枝枝拿起另一件宝物说道。
纪风并没有和他们一起去仙市，但他们买东西时，还记得纪风，给他买了不少的宝贝。
当然，他们也给自己买了一些小玩意。
“哈哈哈，知白，你买的那个太丑了！”
“才不丑呢，这是我用一根须子换来的，很实用好吧。”
“公子公子，你看我这个。”

......
夜色渐深，山中灵灯摇曳，纪风静舍中满是知白他们的说笑声。
接下来两日，依旧有源源不断的仙友从远方匆匆赶来。
有南疆深处的蛊道仙友，有极北冰原的雪域散修......
他们踏入崆峒山山门见到结界护持，确认仙道会尚未开坛，纷纷松了口气，到静舍安顿了下来。
崆峒山中布置也已完善。
九宫道宫门前悬挂七彩灵幡，八台论道台布置完毕，十二院内的器室尽数启封，七十二峰之间架设浮空玉桥，供仙友往来通行。
中台论道主坛铺满千年云锦，四周摆放上万张蒲团，可供上万修士同时观礼。
山中灵泉尽数引流至各座亭台院落，灵果树挂满沉甸甸的仙果，香气飘满群山。
万事俱备，只待开坛吉时。
三日转瞬即逝。
开坛当天，天光初亮，云海初开。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Others are cultivating immortals while I am wandering around, traveling through the three realms to live forever. Volume 1: Default Chapter 288 The Immortal Meeting Begins (..la) "Hey,"
Zhibai smiled and said:
"Sir, this is a good thing we bought at the Fairy Market. Let's bring it to you."
"So many?"
"You have gained a lot."
"Come in and let me see what goodies you have bought."
Ji Feng turned sideways and let Zhibai and the others come in.
As soon as they came in, Zhibai and the others put things on the table.
Ji Feng closed the courtyard door and walked over. He glanced at the table and knew that they bought a lot of things.
Seeing Ji Feng coming over, Zhibai picked up a stone on the table and said:
"Sir, this is Liuyun Yan."
"I heard from Wanwan that this Liuyun inkstone does not require grinding ink. When using it, you only need to stroke the inkstone with your pen to get the ink on it, and the words you write will be the same as Liuyun."
"Master, with this Liuyun Inkstone, you won't need to grind it for writing or drawing in the future."
"And this..."
Taozhizhi picked up another treasure and said.
Ji Feng did not go to the fairy market with them, but when they were shopping, they still remembered Ji Feng and bought him a lot of treasures.
Of course, they also bought themselves some gadgets.
"Hahaha, Zhibai, the one you bought is too ugly!"
"It's not ugly. I got it with a whisker. It's very practical, right?"
"Master, look at me."
...
As the night gets darker, the spiritual lanterns in the mountains are swaying, and Ji Feng’s quiet house is filled with the chatter and laughter of Zhibai and the others.
In the next two days, there was still a steady stream of immortal friends coming from afar.
There are Gu Dao immortal friends deep in southern Xinjiang, and there are casual cultivators in the snowy areas of the far north ice field...
They stepped into the gate of Kongtong Mountain and saw the guardian of the barrier. They confirmed that the Immortal Association had not opened yet. They all breathed a sigh of relief and settled down in the quiet house.
The layout in Kongtong Mountain has also been completed.
Colorful spiritual flags are hung in front of the gate of the Jiugong Taoist Palace, the eight Taoist forums are decorated, all the chambers in the twelve courtyards are unsealed, and floating jade bridges are erected between the seventy-two peaks for the passage of immortal friends.
The main forum on the central stage is covered with thousand-year-old cloud brocade and surrounded by tens of thousands of futons, which can accommodate tens of thousands of monks to watch the ceremony at the same time.
All the spiritual springs in the mountains are diverted to various pavilions and courtyards. The spiritual fruit trees are covered with heavy fairy fruits, and the fragrance fills the mountains.
Everything is ready, just waiting for the auspicious time to open the altar.
Three days passed by in a blink of an eye.
On the day of the opening of the altar, the sky was first bright and the sea of ​​clouds was beginning to open.
